description: The door's own sentence, verbatim in `what` (ErrAgentRefused adds no interpretation — refusals are values, carried to the socket). This one is the SkillAccess default deny (PL5) for the caller's half of the ask: no allow rule matched the ref, so the ask never reached the chain, wrote no edge, and made no task. The remedy is not in this payload on purpose: `aeon policy list --type skill_access` and `agent.discover` answer it.
